seo.title: About Honsgarden — the app for eggs, flock and sales
seo.description: Honsgarden helps backyard chicken keepers log eggs, track the flock, sell eggs with Agda's egg shop, get statistics, reports, community and AI assistance.

header.title: We're building the control panel for backyard chicken keepers
header.subtitle: Honsgarden started as a digital egg log and has grown into a complete tool for following your flock, understanding costs, managing routines, selling eggs, sharing experiences and getting smarter help every day.

why.title: Why {{brand}} exists
why.p1: Keeping chickens is full of small details: today's eggs, the hens' behavior, feed, weather, cleaning, mites, molting, hatchings and sometimes local egg sales. Most of it otherwise ends up in your head, on your phone, on sticky notes or in a spreadsheet.
why.p2: Honsgarden gathers it all in one place. You can log quickly, see patterns over time and get a better overview without it feeling like admin work.
why.p3: With Agda's egg shop you can also create sales pages, take bookings, keep track of customers and follow payment and pickup. That makes Honsgarden a farm journal, dashboard and sales tool in one.
